stories.title: 10-Year Treasury Yield Climbs to Highest Level in Nearly Two Decades
stories.summary: The yield on the 10-year Treasury note has risen to its highest point in almost 20 years, according to CNBC. The move caps a longer climb in long-term borrowing costs rather than a single-day spike.
stories.whyItMatters: Higher 10-year yields raise the cost of mortgages, corporate debt, and government borrowing, and they often weigh on stock valuations.
whatToWatch: Whether yields keep climbing or stabilize in coming sessions
Upcoming Treasury auctions and demand from buyers
Fed officials' comments on rates and inflation
questions: What is driving the rise — inflation expectations, deficit concerns, or term premium?
How high can yields go before it hurts stocks or housing?

stories.title: Study Finds East German Espionage Boosted GDP by 7.4% in Late 1980s
stories.summary: A new study reported by Investing.com finds that East German industrial espionage raised the country's GDP by 7.4% in the late 1980s. The research quantifies the economic payoff of Cold War-era intelligence operations.
stories.whyItMatters: The finding adds a data point to long-running debates over how much stolen technology and trade secrets can boost a national economy.
whatToWatch: Reaction from economic historians and follow-up research
questions: How did researchers isolate espionage's effect from other growth drivers?
Does the estimate hold up under different modeling assumptions?

stories.title: 'Funflation' Rises as Hobbies Get Pricier, But Spending Holds Up
stories.summary: Costs for hobbies and leisure activities are climbing, a trend CNBC calls 'funflation,' yet consumers are continuing to spend on them. The report points to resilient demand for experiences and pastimes despite higher prices.
stories.whyItMatters: Discretionary spending trends help gauge overall consumer resilience, which factors into the broader inflation and spending outlook that markets watch.
whatToWatch: Upcoming consumer spending and inflation data for confirmation of the trend
Whether retailers and leisure companies cite pricing power in earnings
questions: Which categories of 'fun' spending are rising fastest?
How long can consumers keep absorbing higher leisure costs?

stories.whyItMatters: Municipal bonds are a core holding for income-focused and tax-sensitive investors, and yield levels affect how attractive they are versus taxable alternatives.

Investor demand and fund flows into municipal bond funds
